title: Define Widget Testing Pattern

title: Define StacForuiTheme model and parser
description: Create the serializable StacForuiTheme model and its associated StacParser. This includes mapping FColorScheme and FTypography properties to JSON. The parser will wrap its child in a Forui FTheme widget using the parsed theme data. Target forui 0.1.0 API (uses colorScheme instead of colors).
close_reason: Implemented StacForuiTheme model and parser with JSON serialization.
